Getting There

Travel & the château

Château de Sanse

Our venue for the weekend — an 18th century château set among vineyards and cypress trees in the Bordeaux countryside.

View on Google Maps

Nearest Airport

Bordeaux — Merignac (BOD), approximately 1 hour from the château by car.
